title: Rename the check-line merge prefix and its display text to Execution Observability wording
outcome: Host check lines no longer carry the gate-era "[TermAl] Check credit:" label: the merge key (ENGRAM_CHECK_CREDIT_LINE_PREFIX) and its display text use Execution Observability wording consistently across set_pending_source_root_line and every line producer, with the line-merging behaviour unchanged.
acceptance: ENGRAM_CHECK_CREDIT_LINE_PREFIX and its display text are renamed to Execution Observability wording without credit language

set_pending_source_root_line merges the same lines as before under the renamed key, and every producer in engram_carried_checks.rs, claude_outstanding_work.rs and the reported-end/declared-check lines uses it
Tests that assert the old prefix are updated to the new wording and pass
